name: Alfa Transformers Limited
about: Alfa Transformers Limited engages in the manufacture and repair of power and distribution transformers primarily in India. The company offers power transformers from medium to ultra-high voltage (1200 kV AC) and from small (5 MVA) to large power ratings (50 MVA); manufactures customized distributions transformers, 4- or 5-star energy transformers and station transformers that are used in residential, power utilities, industrial, commercial, and the renewable energy sector. It also provides upgrade, repair and refurbishment, in-house and on-site repair, and technical training services. It also exports its products. Alfa Transformers Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Bhubaneswar, India.
